criteria.label: Depicted stance

criteria.label: Explicit call to action
criteria.positive: Is an explicit request to act visible in readable wording or a directly depicted invitation? Use false for clear absence and null for ambiguous or unreadable evidence.
criteria.negative: Expressive poses or dramatic composition alone do not establish a request.
